verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover creating flags and managing per-environment (including production) flag state. Community reports confirm that SDK clients stream flag changes via SSE, so toggles take effect live. The CLI offers another route to create and change flags. Missing for 10: no evidence of the 'within minutes of signing up' onboarding speed (quickstart, free trial or time-to-first-flag), and no hands-on walkthrough of the toggle flow.
